qualityGates: All pediatric investigation cards now carry short UI-safe value tags through testValueLabel/clinicalPriorityLabel.
scoreImpact/scoreValue were added without changing existing answer keys or option-feedback mappings.
clinicalFlowOrder/flowOrder were added so cards sort from pediatric first assessment to emergency safety, basic tests, targeted/confirmatory tests, and follow-up.
Kawasaki ABG/CXR routine use was removed in targeted cases and echocardiography/coronary risk evaluation was added.
HUS ultrasound was demoted to limited contribution and hemolysis/renal/Shiga toxin layers were added.
Sepsis/meningitis cultures and LP now explicitly do not delay antibiotics/resuscitation.
Asthma/bronchiolitis imaging and spirometry are marked situational rather than treatment-delaying.
Neonatal cyanosis has internally consistent pre/postductal saturation and PGE1 delay-prevention note.
Heat stroke CK interpretation was kept in heat stroke/rhabdomyolysis context and active cooling priority was emphasized.
Obvious copied visible context phrases in croup, foreign body aspiration, bronchiolitis and adrenal crisis cases were corrected when they conflicted with the investigation layer.
